items.title: ZeroDivisionError in average_wait
items.summary: Fix ZeroDivisionError in average_wait when waits list is empty.
test:
import sys, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from scheduler import average_wait

waits = []
result = average_wait(waits)
assert result == 0.0, f"Expected 0.0, got {result}"
